Spewpa

Bug

Kalos · Generation 6

Spewpa is a Bug-type Scatterdust Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 8.4 kg. It evolves from Scatterbug and into Vivillon. Its highest base stat is Defense (60), with a base stat total of 213.
